taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA MG1 | Male Genital Tract.

words.clue: The most common single type of testicular germ cell tumor, accounting for approximately 55% of GCTs and highly radiosensitive to radiation therapy.
An undescended testis that increases germ cell tumor risk 3–5-fold in the affected testis and is considered a marker of testicular dysgenesis.
A testicular tumor containing tissue elements derived from two or three germ layers that is NOT benign in adult males unlike in females.
A germ cell tumor resembling placental trophoblasts that secretes β-hCG and is prone to spontaneous hemorrhage.
The most aggressive type of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, resembling early embryonic tissue.
Germ cell neoplasia in situ; the common precursor lesion from which all testicular germ cell tumors arise.
The hallmark cytogenetic abnormality of testicular germ cell tumors involving duplication of the short arm of chromosome 12.
A type of testicular sex cord-stromal cell that can develop into a tumor in any age group.
The most common testicular malignancy in men over 60 years of age, typically of diffuse large B-cell origin.
A 47,XXY chromosomal disorder associated with increased risk of mediastinal and bilateral testicular germ cell tumors.
